concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-paypal-setup-paypal-marketplaces]] — 2026-09-15 PayPal Marketplace setup guide for modern Adyen for Platforms, PayPal/Adyen account permission and TEST/LIVE separation, split/risk integration, and marketplace-owned disputes/refund routing; dated settlement-currency scope is qualified in the source.
warnings: The marketplace account and operator sandbox/live business accounts are not individual seller onboarding or evidence of a specific seller's legal/payment role.
The regional settlement-currency and coming-soon statements are historical to the captured page, not proof of current PayPal merchant eligibility or support.
Refunds through the PayPal portal are specifically warned against because of reconciliation discrepancies; dispute assignment to a seller needs marketplace business logic.
